messages.author: 7e01961f1f4ce874
messages.subject: Error while creating tmp directory
parts:
We are running lots of RMR jobs in our cluster. We have started observing this error quite often now.
Is there any way to avoid this? Looks like it tries to create tmp dir with same name again.
------------------------------
mkdir: cannot create directory /tmp/RtmpJrWIXy: File exists
Error: dfs.mkdir(dfs.tempdir) is not TRUE
Execution halted
Failing Oozie Launcher, Main class [org.apache.oozie.action.hadoop.ShellMain], exit code [1]
------------------------------
Regards
Abhishek

messages.subject: Re: [RHadoop:#1670] Error while creating tmp directory
parts:
Yep, I think I divorced the HDFS tmp setting with the local temp setting since. It was a mistake to have them connected in any way, but they were. hdfs.tempdir now defaults to /tmp and there is a test before trying to create anything. I doubt this error is still possible. Please upgrade to the current release

Antonio

messages.author: 6ac7e7dfbe4f6c38
messages.subject: Re: [RHadoop:#1674] Error while creating tmp directory
parts:
There is this document but it misses on some things, I need to update it. But it's useful. The biggest omission is that when you are confronted with small reduce groups, you have the option of a vectorized reduce, as long as you can reduce multiple groups efficiently (that is, not with an lapply over the groups). Other than that I don't see anything on the fly, but I marked this document for review. If you can share some use cases, it would be a service to the community to discuss them and they may even suggest improvements in rmr2 itself. Building plyrmr on top of rmr2 was alone the biggest driver behind rmr2 3.0 because of the use cases it suggested.


Antonio
